notes: Nominal delivered AC capacity used to scale capital costs. LCOE is mostly scale-neutral because costs are expressed per W or kg.
Delivered grid output divided by required space power. The range is study-authored; external studies are recorded separately as contextual evidence and do not directly define this model input.
Modelled delivered-energy factor combining availability, outages and operating constraints. It is an analytical proxy rather than a measured availability forecast.
Economic operating life. Space-environment degradation and refurbishment are treated separately.

Study-authored real discount-rate range used in the capital-recovery factor. Tax, inflation and detailed financing structure are outside the model, so this is a WACC proxy rather than a fully specified observed WACC.

Mass intensity of the complete orbiting power-generation and transmission architecture per kW of required space power. Published areal density or subsystem-specific-power values are not treated as directly equivalent.
Cost of space solar collection, conversion, structure, control electronics and power conditioning per W of required space power.
Incremental cost of microwave or laser transmission hardware where not included in space hardware.
All-in launch service cost to a model-defined staging orbit. The range is intentionally wide; external launch estimates use different destinations and years and are contextual only.
Cost to move mass from launch insertion orbit to operational orbit when not included in launch price.
Study-authored allowance for robotic assembly, inspection, deployment and commissioning per kg of orbital hardware.
Ground receiving antenna, power conversion and local civil works per W delivered to grid.
Study-authored allowance for grid connection and the local network interface per kW delivered.
Applied to pre-contingency initial CAPEX to reflect programme integration, contingency and owner costs.
Annualized allowance for degradation, electronics replacement and refurbishment.
Operations, ground staffing, insurance, monitoring, station-keeping, maintenance and asset management as a share of CAPEX.
Variable operating cost per delivered MWh.
